verdict.rationale: Square documents a broad set of first-party APIs that cover many core Dashboard and POS functions: payments, catalog, inventory, orders, locations, disputes, payouts, terminal checkout and team management. One example shows the same location editing in both the Dashboard and the Locations API. However, nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates full API/UI parity, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API-to-UI parity statement or coverage matrix, evidence that every Dashboard feature (e.g. cash-flow/banking, payroll execution, account settings) is reachable through the API, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
